access.general.definition: access complaints that match no more specific subtopic, or are too vague to place.

access.password_issues.definition: Complaints that the app will not accept the user's correct password.
access.password_issues.name: Password not accepted

access.phone_verification_problems.name: Phone number verification failure

access.unexpected_logout.definition: User is automatically logged out of their account without action on their part and cannot log back in.
